title: Analysis of Coburn's toe implant: skewed isotopes and nanotech

tellings.quote: Then um he got funding from Haime Masan to uh to remove it a few months later and um he didn't have anybody to analyze it. So um where I was working at the time I had I had [clears throat] access to a lot of analyt analytical equipment.

plain: A small object was taken from the toe of a man named Coburn in California, with money from a man named Haime Masan and through a doctor named Roger Leir, and testing found odd isotope ratios (the mix of atom types in an element) and signs of very tiny engineered parts. The scientist Steve Colbern says he did the testing himself, because the lab where he worked had the equipment and no one else was lined up to do it, and the results were later written up in a paper; he tells it as evidence that the object was not natural or ordinary.
